_note: "The aggregate amount of the deductions under this Chapter shall not, in any case, exceed the gross total income of the assessee" (s.122(2), p.158); "gross total income" is the total income before Chapter VIII (s.122(10), p.159). Every regime: what the new regime keeps of Chapter VIII is bound too. TY 2026-27 and TY 2025-26. rulebook DED-GTI-CAP-001, -DEF-001. Its 1961 counterpart, s.80A(2), is the TY 2025-26 version (W-075d1). TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.80A(2) (thc p.328): "The aggregate amount of the deductions under this Chapter shall not, in any case, exceed the gross total income of the assessee"; s.80B(5) (p.329): gross total income is total income "before making any deduction under this Chapter". sources/2026-10-07-chapter-via.md B1, B3. D-144.
